data.narrative: In Module 08 (Ship It - Production Readiness & Capstone), Alekhya delivered the complete, production-grade Team Collaboration subsystem for TaskFlow API, bridging the last mile from demo to shippable engineering. She orchestrated end-to-end regression protection with a comprehensive 55-test suite (covering permission matrices, edge cases, and a 6-step lifecycle E2E scenario in tests/capstone_e2e.test.js), authored pristine developer documentation (docs/api.md, docs/setup.md, docs/adr.md, docs/rollback.md), integrated an environment-independent GitHub Actions CI workflow, and successfully completed all eight modules of the AI-Augmented Engineering track with 10.0/10.0 mastery.

dimension_scores.observation: Formulated exact, contract-driven production specifications spanning end-to-end integration workflows, permission matrices, and environment-independent CI configurations.
dimension_scores.evidence: Engineered comprehensive testing and documentation requirements that generated hermetic test suites and zero-downtime rollback runbooks.

dimension_scores.observation: Executed rigorous seven-point Ship Checklist sign-off with concrete proof across auth guards, input schemas, test execution, secrets scanning, docs accuracy, CI status, and rollback feasibility.
dimension_scores.evidence: Audited and verified all 7 ship criteria in progress/proof_verify_module_08.json with zero unverified assertions.

dimension_scores.observation: Eliminated ambient environment leakage in a single pass, ensuring all test suites execute in any clean environment in under 490ms.
dimension_scores.evidence: Wrote self-contained test lifecycle hooks across all 13 test files, passing 55/55 tests deterministically.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected Option B (production_grade) ship readiness, correctly balancing the high cost of multi-tenant security/data regressions against cosmetic feature scope.
dimension_scores.evidence: Prioritized permission boundary testing, automated CI gates, and disaster recovery procedures over unhardened feature creep.

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped a fully integrated, zero-dependency, enterprise-grade Team Collaboration subsystem with 100% test pass rates and production documentation.
dimension_scores.evidence: 55 passing automated tests across unit, integration, RBAC, and capstone E2E suites running in 480ms.

strengths: Production-grade engineering discipline: refuses to mistake local demo success for shippable software, enforcing CI gates and rollback plans.
Environment-independent test architecture: builds hermetic, self-contained test suites that eliminate ambient dev state dependencies.
Complete architectural ownership: documents API contracts, setup procedures, ADRs, and failure recovery protocols with exceptional clarity.
growth_areas: Mastery achieved: completed all 8 modules of AI-Augmented Engineering with perfect 10.0/10.0 evaluation scores across all packs (Launchpad, Practitioner, Operator).
data.recommendation: Celebrate full course completion and apply the AI-augmented engineering principles (Interface-First, Context Triangle, Two-Iteration Rule, BFLA Defense) in professional production systems.
